title: Harvard University Affiliated Professor
bio: Mary Lewis is Robert Walton Goelet Professor of French History at Harvard. She specializes in the legal, political, and social history of France and its overseas empire since the 18th century. Her first book was about the development of immigrant rights in interwar France. A co-winner of the 2008 J. Willard Hurst Prize in socio-legal […]
